(601 minutes) |discs= |cassettes= |pages= |isbn=9780593583821 |timeline=[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter''''' is the unabridged audio version of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter|novel of the same name]] by author [[Michael Reaves]]. The audiobook is performed by [[Sam Witwer]] and was released by [[Random House Audio]] on [[August 2]], [[2022]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''. It was produced and directed by [[Kevin Thomsen]], with [[Nick Martorelli]] serving as executive producer. Post-production and sound mixing was done by [[Paul Goodrich]] and editing was done by [[Justin Kilpatrick]].
